name: v0.8.3
body:
## What's Changed
* site: port the marketing page 1:1 to Astro 7 (W1, draft, do not merge before W2) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/93
* site: privacy, 404, sitemap, SEO meta and favicons (W3, draft) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/95
* site: re-record marketing assets on v0.8.2 (W6, draft) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/96
* site: add /sponsor/, /press/, and per-page OG images (W8) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/99
* site: changelog and docs from repo markdown (W5, draft) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/98
* site: add a /download/ page from the latest GitHub Release (W4, draft) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/97
* docs: disclose Cloudflare and Umami on the website (W11, draft) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/100
* site: add Early access signup form behind a build flag (W9, draft) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/101
* site: pin cosign to the release tag and correct arm64 glibc (W4) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/103
* site: add /features/ and refresh the home with W6 media (W7) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/102
* docs: PRIVACY.md Early access list section (waitlist go-live) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/104
* site: turn on Early access in the image build (waitlist flag flip; do not merge before proxy is healthy) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/105
* site: keep the still when a hero or loop video paints blank (t2688u) by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/106
* fix(sync): remember the vault's Drive/GitHub/Tailscale binding in Settings and the tray by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/107
* polish(settings): restyle the Settings page as a full page, not a modal by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/108
* fix(board): don't reload a board whose file was only reformatted by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/110
* Release 0.8.3: bump version and changelog by @raythurman2386 in https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/pull/115


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/raythurman2386/muninn/compare/v0.8.2...v0.8.3
